initial_findings.problem: applied_revision>=1 and error_code IN(...) evaluate NULL for missing values; PostgreSQL CHECK accepts UNKNOWN, allowing applied with null applied_revision or rejected with null error_code.
initial_findings.required_correction: Explicit non-null predicates on the required applied revision and rejected error.
initial_findings.resolution: Corrected candidate adds IS NOT NULL to both branches. Static three-valued-logic review now excludes these malformed shapes. Actual constraint rejection tests remain mandatory.

initial_findings.problem: Initial reserve read workspace without a locking identity fence after outbox acquisition; binding did not preserve the filesystem-verified token/generation. Activation checked current READY and command only, allowing changed generation to be applied using a prior identity validation.
initial_findings.required_correction: Take intent SHARE before outbox and pin verified identity in immutable binding; compare current identity during guarded activation.
initial_findings.resolution: Corrected candidate adds non-null immutable workspace_token/workspace_generation to binding and canonical digest, writes them from the checked intent, takes SHARE in h2_lock_job before outbox and compares exact pin during activation. Mismatch quarantines with no business receipt/update. Actual concurrent mutation tests remain mandatory.

initial_findings.problem: Initial compound CHECK could evaluate UNKNOWN for partially null start metadata instead of enforcing all-or-none. Existing service functions populated all fields together but the intended schema invariant was incomplete.
initial_findings.required_correction: Explicitly require all three populated values in the populated branch.
initial_findings.resolution: Corrected candidate adds uncertain_until/observed_retention_seconds IS NOT NULL and retains bounded time/retention predicates. It also strengthens admitted-state/run and delivery-attempt completion shapes.

reviewed_invariants.assessment: Public worker entry points resolve session_user current OID+name, check role safety/membership and owner-registered active principal. SECURITY DEFINER current_user is not used as caller identity. Admission derives one projector via unique deployment/build assignment; h2_identity sorts dispatcher/projector principal FOR SHARE by OID before lower lock classes.

Mutating multirow paths first authenticate/lock principals, then h2_lock_job takes project guard, membership NOWAIT, job, binding, intent SHARE; outbox follows. Claim/record_delivery use principal plus outbox and no later blocking earlier-class acquisition. Quarantine callers already own job/binding before sorted outbox locks. G5 workspace-only updates do not introduce a reverse job/guard edge. Runtime proof is still required.

project_activation authenticates static job/run/build scope, recomputes fixed complete proposal hash, then reads immutable receipt before current membership/eligibility/workspace checks. Missing receipt takes ordered locks and rechecks receipt before first-apply validation. Existing receipt remains available despite operational quarantine to an active exact-scope principal.

Typed SQL allows only original create activation DRAFT0 to QUEUED1 or fixed rejection retaining DRAFT0. Guarded current owner membership/request.create and unexpired/unrevoked profile eligibility decide first application. Business status, command outcome and immutable receipt are one transaction; dispatch bookkeeping does not advance state.

Generation/token/expiry checks use IS DISTINCT FROM plus fresh clock checks; run UUID canonicalization and write-once binding reject replacement. First-run update and owner-derived projector scope insertion are in the same transaction. Start window cannot extend once set; retention must exceed3600.
